triggerCases.prompt: Review this configuration-format migration for upgrade and rollback compatibility.
Review these new exported component props for API design and type ergonomics.

outputCases.prompt: Review this change for backwards compatibility without modifying the source.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: A read-only compatibility review that identifies a supported-state transition only when the incompatibility is evidenced.
assertions: The review identifies the supported old and new states from the supplied evidence.
Missing rollback coverage is a verification gap unless an incompatible transition is established.
Public API shape concerns are not duplicated from review-api-design.

outputCases.prompt: Review this migration for compatibility and return the findings in chat only. Do not create a review artifact or post anything.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: A read-only compatibility review returned in chat without a local artifact or GitHub write.
assertions: The workflow returns the compatibility findings directly in chat.
The workflow does not create or open a local review document.
The workflow does not modify source or post to GitHub.
